To find stationary points: 1) Calculate first derivative dy/dx or f'(x). 2) Set derivative equal to zero and solve for x. 3) Substitute each x value back into original equation to get corresponding y coordinates. 4) Classify using second derivative test for maxima, minima or inflection.
